children: Stifel maintained their Hold rating on Figma's stock with a price target of $22.00.
The price target implies an upside of 1.1% from the Oct 13 close of $21.76.
Key takeaways from the analyst note

: Figma has solidified itself as the market leader in collaborative UI/UX design tools, demonstrating strong customer demand and positive feedback on its innovative features like Make and the Figma Agent, which are expected to enhance user stickiness and expand its market share.

: The company is currently in an investment cycle aimed at future-proofing its platform with AI functionalities. However, this has led to uncertainty regarding gross margin stability, prompting Stifel to adopt a cautious "Hold" rating until the financial implications of these developments become clearer.
